sentences.zh: 陪审团证明尼尔森的袭击没有明显动机的问题，这可能表明他精神不稳定。

sentences.en: Lawrence put forward that when the two men met at the Golden Lion pub, Nilsen offered
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯提出，当两人在金狮酒吧相遇时，尼尔森向

sentences.zh: 保罗表达了真诚的友谊，并同意陪他去买一些书。

sentences.zh: 然后，尼尔森给保罗做了晚饭，并留他在过夜。

sentences.en: In the morning, when Paul was clearly injured and unwell, Nilsen gave no indication that he was responsible, instead showing genuine concern and suggesting that Paul see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 早上，当保罗明显受伤且身体不适时，尼尔森没有表现出他是罪魁祸首，反而表现出真切的关切，并建议保罗去看医生。

sentences.en: Paul confirmed all of these points to be true and also agreed that Nilsen hadn't tried to coerce him into sex or any acts of sadism or violence.
sentences.zh: 保罗确认所有这些点都是属实的，并同意尼尔森没有强迫他发生性行为或进行任何虐待或暴力行为。

sentences.en: In an attempt to disprove the prosecution's position that Nilsen purposefully targeted
sentences.zh: 为了反驳控方的立场，即尼尔森刻意针对

sentences.zh: 不会被当作失踪人员上报的流浪汉和漂泊者，辩护方指出

sentences.zh: 尼尔森在事发当晚曾允许保罗给母亲打电话。

sentences.en: The next eyewitness to take the stand was survivor Carl Stodder, who was visibly apprehensive as he relayed his terrifying ordeal at Nilsen's Muswell Hill flat.
sentences.zh: 下一个出庭的目击者是幸存者卡尔·斯托德尔，他在讲述自己在尼尔森的马斯韦尔希尔公寓遭遇的可怕经历时，显得明显十分忧虑。

sentences.en: Author Brian Masters later wrote,
sentences.zh: 作家布赖恩·马斯特斯后来写道：

sentences.en: If Paul Nobbs was nervous, Carl Stodder was positively terrified.
sentences.zh: 如果说保罗·诺布斯很紧张，那卡尔·斯托德尔绝对是被吓坏了。

sentences.en: Carl testified that when he first met Nilsen at the Black Cat pub in Camden,
sentences.zh: 卡尔作证说，当他第一次在卡姆登的黑猫酒吧遇到尼尔森时，

sentences.en: Nilsen had asked whether Carl had any family.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森曾问卡尔是否有家人。

sentences.en: Later, at his flat, Nilsen warned Carl that the sleeping bag he was using had a loose zipper.
sentences.zh: 后来，在尼尔森的公寓里，他提醒卡尔，他用的睡袋拉链坏了。

sentences.en: The prosecution put forward that both of these factors indicated that the attempted murder was premeditated.
sentences.zh: 控方提出，这两个因素都表明这起谋杀未遂是有预谋的。

sentences.en: They argued that Nilsen wanted to check whether his victim would be missed by anyone who might
sentences.zh: 他们认为，尼尔森想查明他的受害者是否会被任何试图

sentences.en: attempt to find him, while the mention of the broken zipper implied Nilsen was planning to strangle Carl and gave this warning in case the attack was botched.
sentences.zh: 寻找他的人惦记，而提到拉链坏了则暗示尼尔森正计划勒死卡尔，并给出这个警告以防袭击搞砸。

sentences.en: Nilsen claimed not to recall this attack, which the defence used to infer that he must have had a complete mental block or been dissociating at the time.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森声称不记得这次袭击，辩护方借此推断他当时一定出现了完全的精神空白或解离状态。

sentences.en: Nilsen had escorted Carl to the nearest tube station the day after the assault, which the defence stated further proved his mental instability.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后的第二天，尼尔森曾护送卡尔到最近的地铁站，辩护方称这进一步证明了他的精神不稳定。

sentences.en: Carl also described Nilsen as completely calm before and after the incident, as though he was unaware that he had caused any harm.
sentences.zh: 卡尔还形容尼尔森在事件发生前后完全平静，仿佛他不知道自己造成了任何伤害。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Inspector Peter Jay was also called to testify.
sentences.zh: 侦探总督察彼得·杰伊也被传唤作证。

sentences.en: As well as recounting the events that led to Nilsen's arrest, he read aloud from a number of statements Nilsen had written while in custody, including one from
sentences.zh: 除了回忆导致尼尔森被捕的经过外，他还大声宣读了尼尔森在拘留期间写下的多份陈述，其中包括一份由

sentences.en: February 15, 1983, that Nilsen had titled, Unscrambling Behavior.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森于1983年2月15日写下的、题为《梳理行为》的陈述。

sentences.en: In this statement,
sentences.zh: 在这份陈述中，

sentences.en: Nilsen attempted to explain why he killed, surmising that he was a creative psychopath, who had the power to temporarily lapse into a destructive psychopath when drinking alcohol
sentences.zh: 尼尔森试图解释他为什么要杀人，推测自己是一个有创造力的精神病态者，在酗酒

sentences.en: rapidly.
sentences.zh: 过快时，有能力暂时转变为具有破坏性的精神病态者。

sentences.en: Nielsen explained that at his core, he felt completely socially isolated and was desperately searching for his sexual identity.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森解释说，在他的内心深处，他感到彻底的社会隔离，并一直在拼命寻找自己的性身份。

sentences.en: He also admitted that after murdering his first victim, he had been incapable of having sexual intercourse with a partner for some time.
sentences.zh: 他还承认，在谋杀第一个受害者后的一段时间里，他一直无法与伴侣进行性交。

sentences.en: Nilsson speculated as to the motivation behind his crimes, saying he wished he could blame his actions on jealousy, hate, revenge, sex or robbery,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森推测了其犯罪背后的动机，称他希望自己能把这些行为归咎于嫉妒、恨意、复仇、性欲或抢劫，

sentences.en: but that there was no clinical reason why he attacked.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何临床原因可以解释他为什么会发动袭击。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: God only knows what thoughts go through my mind when it's captive within a destructive binge.
sentences.zh: 上帝才知道当我的思绪陷入毁灭性的狂欢时，脑子里在想些什么。

sentences.en: It may be the perverted overkill of my need to help people.
sentences.zh: 这可能是出于我想要帮助人们这一需求的变态过度。

sentences.en: victims who I decide to release quickly from the slings and arrows of their outrageous fortune, pain and suffering.
sentences.zh: 我决定让这些受害者从他们命运的残酷打击、痛苦和折磨中迅速解脱。

sentences.en: There is no disputing the fact that I am a violent killer under certain circumstances.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，在某些情况下我是一个暴力的杀手。

sentences.en: The victim is the dirty platter after the feast and the washing up is a clinically ordinary task.
sentences.zh: 受害者就像盛宴之后的脏盘子，而洗盘子只是一项临床上再平常不过的任务。

sentences.en: Nielsen also questioned whether his desire to kill was a subconscious primitive instinct, or whether he simply enjoyed the thrill of getting away with murder.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森还质疑，他杀戮的渴望是一种潜意识的原始本能，还是他只是享受逍遥法外的刺激。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: It amazes me I have no tears for the victiMs. I have no tears for myself or for those bereaved by my actions.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，我没有为受害者流泪。我没有为自己流泪，也没有为因我的行为而失去亲人的人流泪。

sentences.en: Am I a wicked person, constantly under pressure, who just cannot cope with it, who escapes to reap revenge against society through the haze of a bottle of spirits?
sentences.zh: 我是一个不断承受压力、无法应对、只能借酒消愁来向社会复仇的邪恶之人吗？

sentences.en: Maybe it's because I was just born an evil man.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为我生来就是一个邪恶的人。

sentences.en: Living with so much violence and death,
sentences.zh: 经历过如此多的暴力和死亡，

sentences.en: I've not been haunted by the souls and ghosts of the dead, leading me to believe that no such
sentences.zh: 我并没有被死者的灵魂和鬼魂所困扰，这让我相信这种虚构的现象过去没有、现在没有、将来也永远不会存在。

sentences.en: fictional phenomena has, does, or ever will exiSt. DCIJ confirmed that Nilsen was unusually
sentences.zh: 高级督察杰伊证实，尼尔森对警察调查异常配合，在描述自己犯下的可怕罪行时也诡异地保持着冷静和淡定。

sentences.en: cooperative with the police investigation, as well as eerily calm and unfazed when describing the horrific acts he had committed.
sentences.zh: 总督察杰弗里·钱伯斯也出庭作证，逐字宣读了尼尔森长篇大论的警方讯问记录，耗时四个小时。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Superintendent Jeffrey Chambers also testified, reading the long transcripts of Nilsen's police interviews verbatim, which took four hours to do.
sentences.zh: 钱伯斯督察表示，当尼尔森描述自己如何剖开腐烂的尸体或煮人头和肉时，没有表现出一丝悔意，也没有任何痛苦或厌恶的迹象。

sentences.en: DCS Chambers said that Nilsen showed no remorse, nor any indication of distress or disgust when describing how he dissected rotting bodies or boiled human heads and flesh.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森用来煮受害者的那口大锅，以及他用于其中一次

sentences.en: The large cooking pot Nilsen had used to boil his victims, as well as the cutting board he had used for one of the
sentences.zh: 分尸的砧板作为证据被出示，这吓坏了陪审团，他们在听到这些叙述时显得紧张且身体不适。

sentences.en: dismemberments, were produced as evidence, much to the horror of the jury, who appeared nervous and physically ill upon hearing the accounts.
sentences.zh: 出席审判的作家布赖恩·马斯特斯回忆说：

sentences.en: Author Brian Masters, who was present at the trial, recalled,
sentences.zh: 审判期间在场的作家布赖恩·马斯特斯回忆道：

sentences.en: At the point when Nilsen had described unpacking bundles of human remains, the stanch and the colonies of maggots, even the judge looked repelled by what he heard.
sentences.zh: 当尼尔森描述解开人类遗骸包裹、支撑物以及成群的蛆虫时，甚至连法官也被他所听到的内容感到反感。

sentences.en: For the first time in the trial, there was much nervous coughing in court.
sentences.zh: 审判中首次出现了法庭内紧张的咳嗽声。

sentences.en: There could hardly have been a more eloquent demonstration of the gulf which divided ordinary men and women from the impassive prisoner in the dock.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更能生动地展示出普通男女与被告席上表情冷漠的囚犯之间的巨大鸿沟。

sentences.en: At this point, it was difficult to believe he was human at all.
sentences.zh: 此时，很难相信他竟然还是个人。

sentences.zh: “罪案档案”稍后回归。

sentences.en: Nilsen's defence team called upon two psychiatrists to support their contention that Nilsen was suffering from abnormality of the mind at the times of his crimes.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的辩护团队传唤了两名精神病学家，以支持他们的主张，即尼尔森在犯罪时患有精神异常。

sentences.en: Forensic psychiatrist Dr James McKeith testified that Nilsen was paranoid, unsure of his own identity, experienced feelings of grandiosity
sentences.zh: 法医精神病学家詹姆斯·麦基思博士作证称，尼尔森患有偏执狂，对自己身份不确定，体验到夸大妄想

sentences.en: and was desperate for the attention of others.
sentences.zh: 并且极度渴望得到他人的关注。

sentences.en: Citing Nilsen's bizarre sexual development and extreme fantasies, Dr McKeith believed he had an obsession with nudity and unconsciousness,
sentences.zh: 麦基思博士指出尼尔森怪异的性发育和极端的幻想，认为他对裸体和失去意识有着迷恋，

sentences.en: which was spurred by his drinking binges and repressed sexuality.
sentences.zh: 这种迷恋是由他的酗酒狂欢和被压抑的性取向所促成的。

sentences.en: He was also hindered by depersonalisation, a state in which an individual experiences a feeling of observing themselves from
sentences.zh: 他还受到人格解体困扰，这是一种个体体验到仿佛在从外部观察自己身体的感觉，

sentences.en: outside their body or senses that their surroundings aren't real.
sentences.zh: 或者感到自己的周围环境是不真实的。

sentences.en: According to Dr.
sentences.zh: 据麦基思

sentences.en: McKeith, this was evident in Nilsen's ability to appear normal and calm at work shortly after having murdered and dismembered victims at home.
sentences.zh: 博士所说，这一点在尼尔森于家中谋杀并肢解受害者后不久，在工作时仍能表现得正常和冷静的能力中显而易见。

sentences.en: As Nilsen had shown a complete lack of remorse, yet considered himself sane, Dr. McKeith diagnosed him as having a severe personality
sentences.zh: 由于尼尔森表现出完全缺乏悔意，却又认为自己神志清醒，麦基思博士诊断他患有严重的人格

sentences.en: disorder, which incorporated paranoid, schizoid, hysterical, and sociopathic tendencies.
sentences.zh: 障碍，其中包含偏执、分裂样、歇斯底里和反社会倾向。

sentences.en: Under cross-examination, the prosecution argued that Nilsen wasn't mentally ill, but intelligent, cunning, quick-witted, and resourceful.
sentences.zh: 在盘问下，控方辩称尼尔森并未患有精神疾病，而是聪明、狡猾、机智且机敏。

sentences.en: They pointed out that his occasional changes of heart when attacking certain victims indicated he was in control and capable of making conscious choices.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，他在攻击某些受害者时偶尔改变心意，表明他是受控的，且有能力做出有意识的选择。

sentences.en: When the prosecution asked Dr McKeith whether he believed that Nilsen was of diminished responsibility, he responded, I cannot answer that as an expert witness.
sentences.zh: 当控方询问麦基思博士是否认为尼尔森承担责任能力减弱时，他回答说：“我不能以专家证人的身份回答这个问题。”

sentences.en: He explained it was up to the court to assess the psychiatric evidence against the legal meaning of diminished responsibility and determine Nilsen's abnormality of mind.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，这取决于法庭根据精神病学证据与责任能力减弱的法律含义进行评估，并确定尼尔森的精神异常状况。

sentences.en: The second forensic psychiatrist to give evidence for the defence was Dr Patrick Galway, who concluded that Nilsen suffered from arrested
sentences.zh: 第二位为辩护方提供证据的法医精神病学家是帕特里克·戈尔韦博士，他得出结论认为尼尔森患有发育停滞的

sentences.en: personality development, which substantially impaired his responsibility for his actions.
sentences.zh: 人格，这大大削弱了他对其行为的责任。

sentences.en: He described Nilsen's condition as false self-syndrome, which was characterised by the
sentences.zh: 他将尼尔森的状况描述为虚假自体综合征，其特征是

sentences.en: combination of paranoid and schizoid elements he exhibited while maintaining a seemingly normal personality.
sentences.zh: 他在维持看似正常人格的同时，表现出的偏执和分裂样元素的组合。

sentences.en: Dr. Galway believed that Nilsen masked his true personality, causing periodic breakdowns whenever the schizoid feature was prominent, which led to his imagination taking over.
sentences.zh: 戈尔韦博士认为，尼尔森掩盖了自己真正的个性，每当分裂样特征突出时就会导致周期性的精神崩溃，从而导致他的想象力接管一切。

sentences.en: By projecting his destruction onto victims that he viewed as objects instead of directing it inwards, Nilsen was able to prevent his mind from entering psychosis.
sentences.zh: 通过将破坏欲投射到被视为物体的受害者身上，而不是将其向内引导，尼尔森得以防止他的大脑进入精神病状态。

sentences.en: During cross-examination, the prosecution put it to Dr. Galway that Nilsen knew intellectually exactly what he was doing when he committed his crimes.
sentences.zh: 在盘问期间，控方对戈尔韦博士提出，尼尔森在犯罪时在理智上完全清楚自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Dr. Galway agreed, but clarified that a person could not know what he was doing unless he also had emotional awareness of it.
sentences.zh: 戈尔韦博士表示同意，但澄清说，一个人不可能知道自己在做什么，除非他对之也有情感上的意识。

sentences.en: He reasoned, quote,
sentences.zh: 他推断道，引述：

sentences.en: I cannot see how Nilsen can be guilty of malice aforethought if he is entirely without feeling, since feeling is an integral part of a person's intent and motivation.
sentences.zh: “如果尼尔森完全没有感情，我无法看出他如何能犯下蓄意谋杀罪，因为感情是个人意图和动机不可或缺的一部分。”

sentences.en: Dr Galway concluded that without the emotional factor, Nilsen would have behaved like a machine, understanding the nature of his actions, but not the meaning of them.
sentences.zh: 戈尔韦博士得出结论，如果没有情感因素，尼尔森就会像机器一样行事，理解他行为的性质，却不理解其意义。

sentences.en: The prosecution called their own expert witness to the stand, Dr Paul Bowden, a Brixton prison psychiatrist who had interviewed Nilsen on
sentences.zh: 控方传唤了他们自己的专家证人保罗·鲍登博士出庭，他是一名布里克斯顿监狱的精神病学家，在过去八个月里曾

sentences.en: 16 separate occasions over the past eight months.
sentences.zh: 16次单独采访过尼尔森。

sentences.en: Dr Bowden rejected the defence psychiatrist's diagnoses, declaring that he found no evidence to suggest Nilsen had a severe personality disorder,
sentences.zh: 鲍登博士拒绝了辩方精神病学家的诊断，宣称他没有发现任何证据表明尼尔森患有严重的人格障碍、

sentences.en: dissociated from his crimes or suffered from arrested development of the mind, either intellectually or emotionally.
sentences.zh: 与其罪行脱节，或者在智力或情感上患有精神发育停滞。

sentences.en: He deduced that there was no inherent cause for Nilsen's behaviour and that he simply enjoyed the feeling of having power over his victiMs. Dr Bowden also
sentences.zh: 他推断尼尔森的行为没有内在原因，他只是享受对受害者拥有权力的感觉。鲍登博士还

sentences.en: suggested that Nilsen killed to transfer the feelings of criminality he had towards being gay to being a murderer instead.
sentences.zh: 暗示，尼尔森杀人是为了将他对同性恋身份的犯罪感转移为对成为凶手的犯罪感。

sentences.en: Dr Bowden rejected the suggestion that Nilsen was remorseless and unemotional, recounting that during one of their sessions together, Nilsen had broken down when
sentences.zh: 鲍登博士拒绝了关于尼尔森毫无悔意且没有感情的说法，他回忆说，在他们的一次会面中，当

sentences.en: pressed about the details of John Howlett's murder.
sentences.zh: 被追问约翰·豪利特谋杀案的细节时，尼尔森崩溃了。

sentences.en: Dr Bowden recalled, quote,
sentences.zh: 鲍登博士回忆说，引述：

sentences.en: Tears filled his eyes and he was about to start crying, and he spoke about never being able to show his feelings.
sentences.zh: “他眼里充满泪水，快要哭出来了，他谈到自己从未能表达过自己的感受。”

sentences.en: Then he got up and walked out.
sentences.zh: 然后他站起身走了出去。

sentences.en: The trial lasted for nine days, with the legal teams delivering their closing remarks on Wednesday November 2, 1983.
sentences.zh: 审判持续了九天，法律团队于1983年11月2日星期三发表了结案陈词。

sentences.en: Prosecutor Green concluded, Dennis Nilsen was free to choose, and he did choose, who to leave alone and who to kill and who to reprieve, and greater power hath no man than this.
